title: Funnel builder + automatic funnel URL system + tags + full tracking + Push live to a NEW path
build_brief: Read the design docs/specs/command-center-design-2026-10-05.md §3.0, §5 (all safety rules incl. 13-18), and the slice named below in §6 in full, plus the spec sections it cites. Units it builds on are merged on main by the time you start (check git log for their merges): reuse their tables, callModel, worker/clock, costs ledger and outbox; never re-create them. (There is no design slice for this unit: it is the owner's order of 2026-10-05.) OWNER ORDER: 'every time a funnel is made we tag it', 'we should have a url system so I don't have to name them, or allow me to name them in the dash', 'we can push a funnel live, /blueprint or similar', test offer = Capital Blueprint book-a-call ($5k-$10k high ticket; src/config/offers.mjs 'consulting-package', $5,000 list price). BUILD, back end first: (1) Funnel model on top of U03's marketing_funnels (add columns only through a migration number the board assigns from lane A/D pools if U03 lacks them): funnel kind 'book_a_call' with ordered pages (landing/VSL page, booking page that frames the existing call calendar the SLO book-a-call funnel uses — read marketing/landing-pages/slo/slo-02-booking.html and /funding-book-call — and a thank-you page), offer code, funnel tag, campaign lane, utm_campaign convention, created_by. (2) URL SYSTEM: on create, generate a short, readable, unique path automatically from the offer (e.g. /blueprint, then /blueprint-2 if taken) by checking the funnel domain's existing pages through the ClickFunnels API (read-only list) AND marketing_funnels; Chris may rename it from the dashboard (POST marketing/funnels/rename), refused if the path exists live or is reserved; never overwrite or change an existing live page or path. (3) TAG + TRACKING: every page gets the full tracking head from marketing/landing-pages/tracking-manifest.mjs (Meta pixel, server events via public/funnel/fh-events.js and fh-attribution.js, GA4 if in the manifest), the funnel tag in the page's tracking config so every event, lead and booking carries the funnel id, UTMs that keep the ad-number law (utm_content = ad number, migration 286; fundhub_ad_id), and Meta Lead/Schedule/Purchase events wired per docs/tracking/meta-events.md. (4) PAGE BUILDER JOB (kind 'funnel', server-side, saved steps on the U22 worker if merged, else the offer background-function pattern): from the approved avatar, offer and copy of the campaign (marketing/flywheel/<campaign>/ files via the outbox/GitHub read, or the marketing_jobs results) write the pages with Anthropic (callModel) using the SLO book-a-call pages and the house brand css as the template; enforce the copy checker and owner copy laws (outcome-first, Fundhub spelling, no SSN mention before checkout step 3 does not apply here but no invented numbers, testimonials only from real sources); save page HTML in the database (and through the outbox when it drains). (5) PUSH LIVE: POST marketing/funnels/push-live (owner/admin, two-tap confirm that names the URL) creates NEW ClickFunnels custom HTML pages through a provider module under src/messaging/providers/ (or the repo's sanctioned CF adapter pattern; reuse scripts/cf-push-custom-html.mjs logic: POST /workspaces/{id}/pages/custom_html, head_code from the tracking manifest), records the live URLs, and proves them with a cache-busted GET; it never PUTs an existing page id it did not create. (6) GET marketing/funnels (list with URL, tag, status draft/live, page links, events seen) and GET marketing/funnel?id=. Contract into docs/specs/marketing-machine-api.md. Tests: unit tests with fake ClickFunnels and fake model; pg tests for the URL uniqueness and tag constraints; prove in GitHub CI. Do NOT push anything live yourself: the main session runs the Blueprint test later.
acceptance: create funnel -> automatic unique path + tag + utm convention stored
rename refused for a taken or live path
every page's head contains the tracking manifest scripts and the funnel tag
push-live creates only new pages and never touches existing page ids (proved with a fake CF)
GET marketing/funnels returns url, tag, status, pages
lint, tsc, unit and pg tests green in GitHub CI (except the known climate test)
